description: NaDyO₂ is Caswellsilverite-like structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. There are two inequivalent Na¹⁺ sites. In the first Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to six O²⁻ atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with four DyO₆ octahedra, edges with five NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with seven DyO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 7-13°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.70 Å. In the second Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to six O²⁻ atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with four DyO₆ octahedra, edges with five NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with seven DyO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 1-13°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.69 Å. There are two inequivalent Dy³⁺ sites. In the first Dy³⁺ site, Dy³⁺ is bonded to six O²⁻ atoms to form DyO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent DyO₆ octahedra, corners with four NaO₆ octahedra, edges with five DyO₆ octahedra, and edges with seven NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 7-13°. There are two shorter (2.28 Å) and four longer (2.30 Å) Dy-O bond lengths. In the second Dy³⁺ site, Dy³⁺ is bonded to six O²⁻ atoms to form DyO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent DyO₆ octahedra, corners with four NaO₆ octahedra, edges with five DyO₆ octahedra, and edges with seven NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 1-13°. All Dy-O bond lengths are 2.29 Å. There are two inequivalent O²⁻ sites. In the first O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded to three Na¹⁺ and three Dy³⁺ atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONa₃Dy₃ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 3-12°. In the second O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded to three Na¹⁺ and three Dy³⁺ atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONa₃Dy₃ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 3-12°.
